children: First Guaranty Bancshares reported third-quarter 2026 net income of $12.0 million, compared with a $45.0 million loss a year earlier. Earnings available to common shareholders were $11.4 million, or $0.69 per share. For the first nine months of 2026, net income was $18.1 million and earnings per share were $1.01.
Third-quarter total business revenue, net of provision for credit losses, was $33.7 million, compared with a loss of $23.8 million in the year-earlier quarter.
Net interest income for the quarter was $17.7 million, down from $22.2 million a year earlier; the provision for credit losses was $3.8 million, compared with $47.9 million.
Third-quarter net income was $12.0 million, versus a net loss of $45.0 million in the third quarter of 2025. Earnings available to common shareholders were $11.4 million, or $0.69 per share.
For the nine months ended September 30, net income was $18.1 million, compared with a $58.5 million loss in 2025; earnings available to common shareholders were $16.4 million, or $1.01 per share.
The Bank’s Tier 1 leverage ratio was 8.29%, and its total risk-based capital ratio was 18.79%.
The company completed the sale of its Texas operations during the quarter.
Substandard assets declined by $31.2 million during the quarter, while special mention and substandard loan balances were reduced significantly from year-end.
Agreements were signed to dispose of the company’s largest OREO property and its second-largest non-performing loan relationship, with both transactions expected to close in the fourth quarter.
The company continued reducing higher-cost funding sources and reported a stronger funding profile and improved liquidity.
